system.description:
This spell instantly teleports the caster and their equipment (but no other creatures) back to the caster's home, provided

the caster is on the same plane and within the same celestial sphere. The caster must have a permanent home for this spell to work, and must have a private bedroom or meditation chamber within that home.

The caster automatically wins initiative in the round that they cast this spell, although it cannot be cast in a surprise round.
